title: Throughline
description: Full-stack AI platform that transforms CliftonStrengths PDF reports into 14 sections of personalized, theme-grounded behavioral insights. Features parallel SSE streaming AI generation, PDF extraction via Anthropic's Files API, Neon PostgreSQL persistence, and a specificity-checking pipeline that auto-rejects generic output. Still under construction — the generation pipeline works end to end, but it is not yet a public release.

title: EPPS Container Optimizer
description: Engineering tool that computes optimal product placement inside shipping containers using 3D bin packing algorithms. Real-time 3D visualization with door clearance validation, multi-solution comparison, and one-click PDF export for logistics teams.

title: Algorithm Visualizer
description: Interactive educational platform visualizing 15+ sorting, searching, graph, and tree algorithms alongside 8 core data structures in real-time. Step-by-step animations with time complexity breakdowns.

title: iREAD
description: Graduation project at Ahram Canadian University, supervised by Dr. Sherif El-Shafey, Head of Software Engineering. A reading platform combining a catalogue with reviews and reading history, a storefront for digital book purchases, and a community layer for readers to exchange insights — served by a single REST API feeding both the Flutter mobile client and the React web client, keeping one source of business logic across platforms.
